_note: The Emberwaste, level 12: a journey into heat. See docs/zones.md.

exposure.name: heat
exposure.warn: Your tongue is like leather and the world is swimming. Get into shade.
exposure.relief: Shade, and water. You come back to yourself.

exposure.warn: Your tongue is like leather and the world is swimming. Get into shade.
exposure.relief: Shade, and water. You come back to yourself.

ash_road_1.name: The Ash Road
ash_road_1.description: The road east gets greyer, then black. Ash drifts across it.

ash_road_2.name: The Cinder Flats
ash_road_2.description: Flat black ground to the horizon. The heat comes up through your boots.

ash_road_3.name: The Glass Gate
ash_road_3.description: Two pillars of black glass, and beyond them the Emberwaste.

ew_serai.name: The Caravanserai
ew_serai.description: A walled caravanserai of black stone, with shade, a cistern and tired camels.

ew_well.name: The Dry Well
ew_well.description: A well that's been dry for a year. Saffa sits on its rim, counting water-skins.

ew_tent.name: Ithren's Tent
ew_tent.description: A tent of red silk, much mended. Its owner was somebody once.

ew_barrens.name: The Glass Barrens
ew_barrens.description: Ground fused to black glass, cracked like ice. The air shimmers.

ew_spring.name: The Glass Spring
ew_spring.description: A spring that bubbles up hot through glass, in the shade of an ash-rock.

features.spring: Hot, but drinkable once it cools.

ew_dunes.name: The Ash Dunes
ew_dunes.description: Dunes of grey ash. Things move under them.

ew_rim.name: The Caldera Rim
ew_rim.description: The rim of a vast crater, smoking. A path winds down.

ew_hotspring.name: The Sulphur Pool
ew_hotspring.description: A yellow pool, steaming. Salamanders bask on its edge.

features.pool: Under the sulphur crust, clean hot water.

ew_heart.name: The Caldera's Heart
ew_heart.description: The crater floor, glowing in its cracks. Something stands here like a hill of slag. Behind it, the air tears open onto fire and spires.

features.tear: A rift onto a city of black glass and fire.

caravan.text: The Ash Road to the Emberwaste. Fifteen coins and you ride with the water barrels.
caravan.explains: TRAVEL CARAVANSERAI to take it (15 coins).

topics.emberwaste: Hot enough to kill you. Saffa keeps the caravanserai out there.

saffa.name: Saffa
saffa.label: Caravan-mistress
saffa.description: a woman in a white veil with a whip on her belt
saffa.details: A woman in a white veil with a whip on her belt.

topics.work: Ask me about the wraps, the water, or the wyrms.

wraps.text: Out there the heat cooks you a step at a time. Wraps, wet, over your head. Ask me for the wraps.

water.text: The well's dry. Take these skins to the Glass Spring in the barrens and the Sulphur Pool in the caldera, fill them, and bring them back.

wyrms.text: Ash wyrms. Five of them, and the road's safe for a season. They come up under you: dodge.

ithren.name: Ithren
ithren.label: Exile
ithren.description: a woman with ember-red eyes and a court accent
ithren.details: A woman with ember-red eyes and a court accent.

courts.text: The Ember Courts. My home, before the Ashen Duke had me thrown out. The rift's in the caldera's heart. Tell the gatekeeper, Ruuk, that Ithren sends you, and he'll let you in.

topics.duke: The Ashen Duke. He'll steal the Ember Crown one day. Mark me.

ash_wyrm_1.label: Wyrm
ash_wyrm_1.description: a long grey wyrm that swims through the ash
ash_wyrm_1.details: A long grey wyrm that swims through the ash.

cinder_colossus.name: the Cinder Colossus
cinder_colossus.label: Colossus
cinder_colossus.description: a giant of slag and fire, standing guard before the rift
cinder_colossus.details: A giant of slag and fire, standing guard before the rift.

attacks.name: fist
attacks.hit: {actor} swings a fist of slag at {target}.

glass_blade.name: Glass Blade
glass_blade.description: A knife of black glass from the barrens. Sharpest in the heat.

desert_wraps.name: Desert Wraps
desert_wraps.description: Wet linen wraps for the head and face. Keeps off the heat.

wyrmscale_vest.name: Wyrmscale Vest
wyrmscale_vest.description: Ash-wyrm scales riveted to leather. +1 Resilience.

ash-road.name: the Ash Road caravan
ash-road.depart: You pay Teodor and climb onto the water wagon. The caravan grinds east.
ash-road.leave: {actor} climbs aboard the Ash Road caravan.
ash-road.arrive: The caravan creaks into the caravanserai, and {actor} climbs down, coughing ash.

ash-road-back.name: the Ash Road caravan
ash-road-back.depart: You climb onto an empty water wagon heading back west.
ash-road-back.leave: {actor} rides west with the empty wagons.
ash-road-back.arrive: The caravan rolls in to the quarry gate, and {actor} climbs down.

ash_storm.text: A wall of ash rolls across the flats towards the caravan. The camels groan and kneel.

choices.label: Get under the wagon and cover your face

success.text: You ride it out, breathing through cloth. It passes.

failure.text: The ash gets in your lungs. You cough blood for an hour.

choices.label: Push the camels on through it

success.text: You drag them through, and come out the far side ahead of schedule.

failure.text: A camel bolts and you go after it. The storm swallows you both.

glass_mirage.text: Off to the south, a lake shimmers, with palms and white walls. The drivers won't look at it.

success.text: "The Glass Prophet's city. It isn't there. People who go to it aren't, either."
You see through it in time: just heat and glass. You walk back, shaking.

failure.text: You walk for an hour before you understand. The caravan has gone on without you.

wraps.goal: Ask Saffa for it: ASK SAFFA ABOUT WRAPS.

effects.text: Saffa wets the wraps and ties them on you herself. "WEAR WRAPS out there. Shade at the Glass Spring and here. Nowhere else."

skins.goal: Take the skins: ASK SAFFA ABOUT SKINS.

spring.goal: Fill them at the Glass Spring, north-east in the barrens: USE SKINS ON SPRING.

effects.text: The skins fill, hot and heavy.

pool.goal: And at the Sulphur Pool in the caldera: USE SKINS ON POOL.

effects.text: You break the crust and fill the rest.

back.goal: Bring them back to Saffa: USE SKINS ON SAFFA.

effects.text: Saffa weighs each one. "Enough for a month. Here: glass from the barrens, for your trouble."

kill.goal: Kill five ash wyrms in the barrens and the caldera.

back.goal: Tell Saffa: ASK SAFFA ABOUT WYRMS.

ruuk.goal: Get past the Cinder Colossus to the rift in the caldera's heart, cross into the Ember Courts, and ASK RUUK ABOUT ITHREN.

effects.text: Ruuk's ember eyes flare. "Ithren lives? Then you may pass, friend of hers."

reputation.note: A friend of the exile Ithren.
